items.title: David Friesen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember, Irv Kratka. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Exactly. Is he still with us?

ctx.x: Well you bring back something that I did when I was going to New York. You know from Portland, Oregon to New York City it’s almost four days non-stop with another person. Stopping for gas, stopping for food, but not staying overnight. So from Portland to New York — and I’ve made this trip 26 times in my life. And I remember driving back to New York a few times and I had record dates on Inner City Records. This is in those early —
Yeah. Exactly. Is he still with us?
